case.title: Little Red Riding Hood, anime
case.request: make a 30 second video of Little Red Riding Hood but in anime style. Red walks through the forest with her basket, meets the wolf, reaches grandma's cottage, the wolf in grandma's bed, the woodcutter bursts in and saves the day. Studio-Ghibli-like hand-drawn anime look, warm and whimsical, music and ambient sound, no dialogue.

plan.style: Warm, whimsical hand-drawn anime with expressive faces, watercolor backgrounds, soft pencil textures, mossy greens and scarlet accents, golden forest light and cozy amber interiors.

characters.name: Little Red Riding Hood
characters.look: A small girl about eight years old with a round face, rosy cheeks, large brown eyes and a short chestnut bob; she wears a scarlet hooded cloak, cream dress, brown ankle boots and white stockings.

characters.name: Wolf
characters.look: A tall, lanky anthropomorphic wolf with charcoal-gray fur, a cream muzzle and chest, amber eyes, pointed ears, enormous paws and a long bushy tail.

characters.name: Grandma
characters.look: A short elderly woman with a softly lined round face, kind brown eyes, round spectacles and silver hair in a neat bun; she wears a lavender nightgown and soft plum slippers.

characters.name: Woodcutter
characters.look: A broad-shouldered middle-aged man with a square face, brown eyes, a short chestnut beard and wavy chestnut hair; he wears a rolled-sleeve green shirt, brown suspenders, tan trousers and heavy brown boots.

keyframes.description: A wide view shows a winding woodland path beneath tall leafy trees. Little Red Riding Hood stands mid-step near the center, facing right, with a honey-colored wicker basket in her right hand. Her scarlet cloak lifts slightly behind her. Mossy roots, ferns and tiny white flowers border the path; golden shafts of sunlight cross the ground.

keyframes.change: Keep the forest composition and bring Wolf out from behind the large tree on the right. Stop Little Red Riding Hood mid-path and turn her face toward Wolf.
keyframes.description: Little Red Riding Hood stands on the left side of the sunlit path, her basket hanging from her right hand. Wolf stands beside the large tree on the right, one paw resting against its trunk. Wolf leans forward with an exaggeratedly polite, closed-mouth smile. Ferns surround Wolf's feet.

keyframes.change: Widen the view to reveal a distant cottage between the trees. Raise Little Red Riding Hood's free left arm toward it and turn Wolf's gaze in the same direction.
keyframes.description: Little Red Riding Hood stands at the left foreground, smiling and pointing with her left hand toward a tiny cottage in the upper-right distance. Her basket remains in her right hand. Wolf stands on the right, looking toward the cottage. The cottage has cream plaster walls, a steep red-tiled roof, a blue wooden door, a square window to the door's right and colorful flower beds.

keyframes.change: Move closer to the characters, cropping the cottage out. Lower Little Red Riding Hood's pointing arm. Bend Wolf into a theatrical bow at the edge of the undergrowth, with one foot turned away from the path.
keyframes.description: In a medium view, Little Red Riding Hood stands on the left with a relaxed smile and her basket at her right side. Wolf bows on the right, one enormous paw against Wolf's cream chest and the other parting a fern. Wolf's body angles toward a narrow gap in the bushes. Dappled sunlight falls across both figures.

keyframes.change: Advance along the path to the cottage exterior and remove Wolf from view. Place Little Red Riding Hood at the doorstep, reaching for the blue door with her left hand.
keyframes.description: The flower-covered cottage fills the frame: cream plaster walls, a steep red-tiled roof, a blue wooden door and a square window to its right. Little Red Riding Hood stands on the stone doorstep with her left hand against the partly open door and her wicker basket in her right hand. Pink hollyhocks and yellow daisies crowd the walls. Sunlit forest surrounds the clearing.

refs.take: The cottage's cream plaster walls, steep red-tiled roof, blue door, square window to the door's right and colorful flower beds.

keyframes.change: Move through the doorway into the bedroom. Place Little Red Riding Hood inside on the left and reveal Wolf tucked into the bed on the right, now wearing a white frilly nightcap.
keyframes.description: A wide bedroom view places the open blue entrance door at the far left, a closed oak wardrobe against the back-left wall and a wooden bed along the right wall. An open square window above the bed's foot reveals green foliage. Wolf lies propped against cream pillows under a sage-green patchwork quilt, wearing a white frilly nightcap with pointed ears protruding. Wolf's huge paws rest on the quilt. Little Red Riding Hood stands left of the bed, holding her basket in her right hand. Amber daylight warms the wooden floor.

refs.take: Wolf's charcoal-gray fur, cream muzzle, amber eyes, pointed ears and enormous paws.

keyframes.change: Lean Wolf forward, pull the quilt tight in Wolf's paws and open Wolf's smile to expose sharp teeth. Move Little Red Riding Hood a step backward and set her basket upright on the floor beside her right boot.
keyframes.description: Wolf sits higher in the bed on the right, pointed ears upright through the frilly nightcap. Wolf's enormous paws clutch the sage-green patchwork quilt, and a broad grin exposes sharp white teeth. Little Red Riding Hood recoils at center-left with wide eyes and both hands raised near her chest. Her wicker basket stands upright beside her right boot. The wardrobe remains closed, and the window above the bed's foot remains open.

keyframes.change: Swing the entrance door hard inward and add Woodcutter striding across the threshold with an axe held low. Turn Little Red Riding Hood toward Woodcutter and change Wolf's grin to a startled expression.
keyframes.description: The blue entrance door stands flung inward at the far left. Woodcutter strides into the bedroom, gripping a wooden-handled axe low in his right hand with its blade pointed toward the floor. Little Red Riding Hood stands just to his right, looking up at him; her basket remains beside her boots. Wolf sits rigidly in the bed, eyes wide and mouth closed, paws frozen on the quilt. The wardrobe is closed behind them, and the open window admits warm sunlight.

keyframes.change: Move Woodcutter between Little Red Riding Hood and the bed. Pull the quilt aside and move Wolf out of bed into the open window, forepaws on the sill and one hind leg lifted over it.
keyframes.description: Woodcutter stands at center with his broad back partly toward Little Red Riding Hood, the axe still lowered at his right side. Little Red Riding Hood peers around his left arm, with her basket on the floor nearby. On the right, Wolf scrambles through the open window, front paws braced on the sill, one hind leg over the edge and bushy tail still inside. The white frilly nightcap remains on Wolf's head. The bed is empty, its sage-green quilt rumpled toward the foot. The oak wardrobe remains shut.

keyframes.change: Remove Wolf completely through the window. Open the wardrobe doors and reveal Grandma stepping out unharmed. Turn Little Red Riding Hood and Woodcutter toward Grandma, relaxing their expressions.
keyframes.description: Grandma steps from the open oak wardrobe at the back-left, one hand on its door and the other extended toward Little Red Riding Hood. Little Red Riding Hood faces Grandma with a bright, relieved smile. Woodcutter stands at center-right with relaxed shoulders and his axe pointed down beside his boot. The wicker basket remains upright on the floor near Little Red Riding Hood. The rumpled bed is empty, and only sunlit leaves are visible through the open window.

keyframes.change: Bring Grandma and Little Red Riding Hood together in a hug in the center-left foreground. Shift to a slightly closer framing while retaining Woodcutter, the empty bed and the open window.
keyframes.description: Grandma bends to embrace Little Red Riding Hood at center-left, both smiling with their cheeks pressed together. Little Red Riding Hood's scarlet cloak drapes around Grandma's lavender sleeves. The wicker basket rests upright at their feet. Woodcutter stands to the right with a gentle smile, holding the axe safely down at his outer side. Behind them, the wardrobe doors stand open, the bed holds its rumpled sage-green quilt and the open window frames golden-green leaves and a small bird on a branch. Soft amber light fills the room.
